hooks.name: Run Service Tests on Python File Save
hooks.description: When a .py file inside services/ is saved, runs pytest for that service and reports failures.

action.command:
python -c "
import sys, json, re, subprocess, os

data = json.load(sys.stdin)
path = data.get('file', '')

m = re.search(r'services[\\/]([^\\/]+)[\\/]', path)
if not m:
    sys.exit(0)

service = m.group(1)
test_dir = os.path.join('services', service, 'tests')

if not os.path.isdir(test_dir):
    sys.exit(0)

result = subprocess.run(
    ['pytest', test_dir, f'--cov=app', '--tb=short', '-q'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)

if result.returncode != 0:
    print(f'TESTS FAILED for service [{service}]:\n{result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}')
    sys.exit(1)

sys.exit(0)
"
